- Agent 1 (Detector): Anomali tespiti — NODE_FAILURE, ROUTING_FAIL, LATENCY_SPIKE, TOPOLOGY_CHANGE, PACKET_LOSS

- ROUTING_FAILURE → Route re-probe + RPL local repair
- TOPOLOGY_CHANGE → Parent switch logging
